book.name: MATEUS
book.title: MATEUS Mateus nu pasa mayenu Yesus Kristus tuku kuyarna

content: Yesus nu Olif tabe mbolŋge pasa kuklina
Yesus nu maŋgur suŋgo ta kaŋgerka nu tabe poŋga minyok minna le nuŋe dubinaig mbal nu tugum pronaig.
Gare tugusek tuku pasa
Nane nu tugum pronaig le nu nane wam paguka saniŋgina:
Tane Kuate am mbolŋge kumuŋ kuga ŋga kamusde mbal tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Tane Kuate tuku ma mbol kambim tuku minig.
Tane ŋgamuŋgal rar tumba malmbika minig mbal tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Kuate nu tane tuku ŋgamuŋgal rar ta bul sertiŋgamŋgat.
Tane ŋgan mukuknu minig mbal tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Tane kilke tugu ŋakmba kulatkam tuku minig.
Tane tiŋreknu mayok kambim tuku dirnaŋga minig mbal tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Kuate nu lafunu kumumbi tiŋgamŋgat.
Tane taŋgo mapekade mbal tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Kuate nu mata tane mapekamŋgat.
Tane ŋgamuŋgal purfeŋnu minig mbal tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Tane Kuate kaŋgeramŋgaig.
Tane taŋgo tuku gubra peuka ŋgamuŋgal mukuk niŋgig mbal tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Tane Kuate tuku kiŋo kame minamŋgaig.
Tane Kuate dubimba maŋau tiŋreknu ke likade le afuŋge tane piti tiŋgig ta tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap. Tane Kuate tuku ma mbol kambim tuku minig.
Tane ye tuku mbal minig tukunu afuŋge tane tumail pantiŋmba piti sertiŋmba yabri pasa suŋgombambi ake tulitiŋgig ta tane gare maŋau mbolŋge minap.
Nane taŋawaig kande tane gare torap. Samba mbolŋge tane tuku lafu mayenu minit. O buk nane Kuate tuku tuan taŋgo kilmba piti ndui ta ndo niŋginaig.
Sol le sati tuku yaba pasa

Tane sol kaglinu taŋaŋ kilke te mbolok mbal ŋgamukŋge minig. Sol kaglinu kugawa le sine ame agaŋmbi maŋ wakeibe le kaglinu mayok kambim kumuŋ? Kumuŋ kuga. Nu piro kugatok. Nane ake kutumba bareŋguwaig le taŋgo pinoŋge tido-tidoŋga likamŋgaig.
Tane sati taŋaŋ kilke te mbolok mbal kilŋaniŋgig le ndin kaŋgerde. Tumbraŋ ande tabe mbolŋge minit ta nu kuirka minam kumuŋ kuga.
Taŋgo nane lam bulumba nza kai ndade. Nane te-mayokmba taikade le nane ŋakmba wandek sinamŋge minig ta kilŋaniŋgit.
Taŋamba ndo tane taŋgo pino ŋgamukŋge sati taŋaŋ buluŋga minap le nane tane kaŋgertiŋmba taŋgine Mam samba mbolŋge minit nu tuku nyu te-duŋguwaig.
Tukul pasa tuku pasa
Ye tukul pasa tuan taŋgo kame tuku pasa pitaikam prowen ŋga idus ndawap. Ye pasa ta kumu-kumumba alonu kile-mayokkam prowen.
Tane pasa te ise tiwap. Tukul pasa fambonu inum fudiŋndo ŋgisi ndaka minwa le ma ma wam kame te ŋakmba kumuŋguwaig le samba kilke kugawamŋgaik.

Ande nu tukul pasa fudiŋndo inum te-ibeŋmba baklel sermba afu tumniŋguwa ta nu Kuate tuku gageu ŋgamukŋge nyu kugatok minamŋgat. Ande nu tukul pasa ŋakmba dubika afu tumniŋguwa ta nu Kuate tuku gageu ŋgamukŋge nyu ŋak minamŋgat.
Ye tane satiŋgamŋgit. Tane maŋau magenu kumba Farisi le kusem pasa bitekŋganu mbal tuku maŋau magenu li ndaniŋgap ta tane Kuate kulatkate ma ta mbol kine nda.
Gubra maŋau tuku pasa
Moses nu siŋgine wa mbuŋ kame teŋenmba saniŋgina.

content.text: Taŋgo bale ndawap. Andeŋge taŋgo balewa kande nu pasa mbolŋge te-tiwap ŋgina. Lo 5.17

content: Pasa ta tane isnaig.

Ye tane teŋenmba satiŋgamŋgit. Ande nu tira nuŋe tuku gubra ndo tuwa kande nu mata pasa mbolŋge te-tiwap. Ande nu tira nuŋe tumail panmba agaŋmor taŋaŋ wamdus kugatok ŋga sawa ta nu pasa suŋgo mbolŋge te-tiwap. Ande nu nuŋe tira tapramba ŋginŋgan taŋgo ŋga sawa ta nu ma ŋayo tuku pa mbol kambim tuku minit.
Ta tuku ne Kuate atraukam ŋga tira naŋe ne ndoŋ gubra ŋak minit ta idusmba kande ne Kuate atrau ndaka.
Agaŋ ta atrau mbain tugumŋge kusremba luka kumba ka naŋe tira ndoŋ wamdus tumawap sulumba luka pro Kuate atrauka.
Mbar kile-tidiŋgam tuku pasa

Taŋgo ande ne pasa mbolŋge pilmba pasa pilewanu wande mbol kambim saka kumba ka ndinŋge nu ndoŋ pitik ndo wamdus tumawa. Kuga ta nu ne tumba ka pasa pilewanu taŋgo tuku wai mbol pilwa le nuŋge ne tumba muli wande kulatkate taŋgo ta tuwa le ne muli wandek sinamŋge palmbimŋgat.
Ye siŋka tane satiŋgamŋgit. Naŋe mbar tuku piya suŋgo ta kumumba fudiŋndo lafu sulu ndawa ta ne muli wandek sinamŋge prowe nda.
Taŋgo pino kuayarde tuku pasa
Moses nu teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Taŋgo pino muŋgu kuayar ndakap ŋgina. Lo 5.18

content: Pasa ta tane isnaig.
Ye tane teŋenmba satiŋgamŋgit. Ande nu ammbi pino kaŋgerte sulumba am kikoŋ tiŋgate le wamdus ŋayonu tate ta nu buk wamdusmbi pino ta kuayarmba unekate.
Ne tuku am ndinamŋge ne unekam tuku didikate ndeta gomba bukŋga. Ne tuku ŋgarosu inumnu taŋamba ŋgisi ndakuwa le ne ŋgarosu ŋakmba kumumbi minwaig ta ne ma ŋayo mbol kaŋgat.
Ne tuku wai ndinamŋge ne unekam tuku didikate ndeta pike purmba bukŋga. Ne tuku ŋgarosu inumnu taŋamba ŋgisi ndakuwa le ne ŋgarosu ŋakmba kumumbi minwaig ta ne ma ŋayo mbol kaŋgat.
Taŋgo pino muŋgu purkik tuku pasa
Moses nu pasa ande teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Ima nu piyo nuŋe pitaiwam ndeta nu pitaiwam tuku waŋe kuyarmba tuwa ŋga sakina. Lo 24.1-4

content: Ye tane teŋenmba satiŋgamŋgit. Pino ande nu taŋgo ande ndoŋ fare mine ndakate le taŋgo nuŋeŋge nu maŋau kise tuku pitaite le nu kumba taŋgo kise tate ta nu taŋgo ambokok tuku mbar mbolŋge nu taŋgo kuayarmba unekate. Taŋgo kitek ta nu mata pino kuayarmba unekate.
Pasa saŋgri pilewam tuku pasa
Moses nu wa mbuŋ kame pasa ande teŋenmba saniŋgina.

content.text: Tane pasa saŋgri pilede ta kusre ndawap. Kuate am mbolŋge pasa ta kumuwap ŋgina. Lo 23.21

content: Pasa ta tane isnaig.
Ye tane teŋenmba satiŋgamŋgit. Tane pasa ande saŋgri pile ndawap. Tane pasa saŋgri pilewam tuku samba kilke nyu nda tap. Samba Kuate minit tuku ma.
Kilke Kuate kupe patikate tuku ma. Yerusalem mata nyu nda tap. Tumbraŋ suŋgo ta Kuate Suŋgo tuku tumbraŋ.
Tane taŋgine gabat mata nyu nda tap. Ata. Tane taŋgine gabat waŋe inum kaukauk ko dabuk dabuk te-mayokam tuku tane saŋgri kugatok.
Tane au ŋgumba kande au ndo ŋgap. Kuga ŋgumba kande kuga ndo ŋgap. Tane saŋgri pilewam tuku pasa tuturte ta Satan tugumŋge ilit.
Mbar lafu maŋau tuku pasa
Moses nu teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Taŋgo andeŋge ande tuku am gowa kande lafumba nu tuku am mata gowap.
Taŋgo andeŋge ande tuku maketiŋ ŋgurwa kande lafumba nu tuku maketiŋ mata ŋgurap ŋgina. Lo 19.21

content: Pasa ta tane isnaig.
Ye tane teŋenmba satiŋgamŋgit. Taŋgo ande nu ne ŋayo silinuwa kande ne lafu ndawa. Ande nu ne tuku dabil ndinam pannuwa ndeta ne mbilka dabil inum tawe le pannuwa.
Taŋgo ande nu ne tumba pasa mbolŋge pilmba ne tuku tawi tuwa ndeta ne naŋe tawi ande turmba tawe.
Taŋgo ande nu agaŋ ande pitinu neŋge turmba diram tuku sarsarmba sanuwa kande ne agaŋ ta tumba nu ndoŋ kumba ka lukam tuku ma ta limba ka palmbim tuku ma mbol pale.
Ande nu agaŋ ande tuku yabaŋnuwa kande nu tawe. Ande nu ne tuku agaŋ tumba ŋgumneŋga ne luka tanmbimŋgit ŋga sanuwa ndeta mbule ndaka nu tawe.
Ŋgueu mbal ŋgamuŋgal niŋgam tuku pasa
Moses nu teŋenmba sakina.

content.text: Tane taŋgine gulab kame tuku kume purmba taŋgine ŋgueu taŋgo kasurniŋgap ŋgina. Wok Pris 19.18

content: Pasa ta tane isnaig.
Ye tane teŋenmba satiŋgamŋgit. Taŋgine ŋgueu mbal tuku kume purap. Nane afu tane kilmba piti sertiŋgig mbal nane sinanu Kuate yabaŋap.

Tane taŋawap ta taŋgine Mam samba mbolokŋge minit nu tuku kiŋo kame minmba nu tuku maŋau te-purde. Nuŋge ki siŋgit le taŋgo magenu ŋaigonu turmba mbol prote. Nuŋge sawe siŋgit le taŋgo tiŋreknu taŋgo une ŋak turmba turkate.
Nane afu tane tuku kume purwaig le tane ndek nane tuku kume purmba Kuate nu wam ta tuku lafunu mayenu tiŋgamŋgat ŋga idus ndawap. Takis kilanu mbal ŋaigonu nane mata wam ndui ta ndo kade tae.
Taŋgine tira kame ndo kile-tawokkap ta tane Kuate ŋgumnede mbal li ndaniŋgig. Kuate gilai mbal nane mata taŋade tae.
Taŋgine Mam samba mbolŋge minit nu taŋgo ŋakmba mbolŋge maŋau magete taŋamba tane mata nane ŋakmba mbolŋge maŋau magewap.

footnotes.text: Yesus nu Olif tabe mbolŋge pasa kuklina ta sapta 5.3 mbol tugu pilmba ka sapta 7.27 mbolŋge tiŋgina.
